g1.label: 1. Time of the assembly?
g1.why: The recording says the special assembly is at nine o'clock.

g2.label: 2. Where is the poster exhibition?
g2.why: The recording says the poster exhibition is in the courtyard.

g3.label: 3. Who to meet for litter-picking?
g3.why: The recording says students should meet Mr Owusu for litter-picking.

g4.label: 4. What to bring if possible?
g4.why: The recording says students should bring gloves if they have them.

g5.label: 5. When are permission slips due?
g5.why: The recording says permission slips must be returned by Wednesday.

g6.label: 6. What does Ollie need?
g6.why: The recording says Ollie needs his parents to sign the permission slip before Friday.

g7.label: 7. What might the assembly do?
g7.why: The recording says Ollie thinks the assembly might inspire more people to get involved.

g8.label: 8. Ollie's opinion on missing lessons
g8.why: The recording says Ollie would rather still get an education than miss a full day of lessons.

g1.label: 1. Zoe's attitude
g1.why: The text says Zoe thinks missing school to protest sends a powerful message.

g2.label: 2. Theo's attitude
g2.why: The text says Theo would rather join clubs and projects that clean up the local area.

g3.label: 3. Marco's attitude
g3.why: The text says Marco doesn't think one person can change something this big.

g4.label: 4. Iris's attitude
g4.why: The text says Iris reads the news but isn't sure what she can actually do to help.

g5.label: 5. Assembly starts at nine
g5.why: The text confirms the assembly starts at nine o'clock.

g6.label: 6. Gloves required, no exceptions
g6.why: The text says litter-pickers should bring gloves if possible, not that gloves are strictly required.

g7.label: 7. Slips due by Friday
g7.why: The text says permission slips are due by Wednesday, not Friday.

g8.label: 8. Lessons cancelled all day
g8.why: The text says normal lessons continue as usual in the morning.
